title: TerraFlow: AI-Assisted Site Walk & Landscape Co-Design

brief.frame_rationale: Shifting from a static CAD-lite dashboard to a conversational 'site walk' makes the AI a collaborative reasoning partner, highlighting its ability to extract physical constraints from video and iteratively design in context.
brief.concept_title: TerraFlow: AI-Assisted Site Walk & Landscape Co-Design
brief.one_line_thesis: An interactive, conversational workspace that turns raw backyard video into constraint-aware landscape designs and material specs.

primary_persona.name: Elena, Independent Landscape Designer
primary_persona.context: Runs a boutique 3-person design-build firm. Spends 10+ hours per prospect measuring grades, calculating sun exposure, and drafting initial concepts before a client even signs a contract.
primary_persona.emotional_state: Frustrated by the tedious math of site constraints and the time wasted on unqualified leads; wants to spend more time on creative vision and less on manual surveying.

secondary_actors.involvement: Receives the final interactive proposal generated from Elena's session to approve budget and layout.

brief.demonstrated_moment: The 'Initial Site Synthesis & Zoning' phase. Elena has just uploaded a 30-second site walkthrough video. The prototype shows the AI extracting constraints, Elena chatting to establish zones, and the system generating a spatial layout and preliminary material list.
jobs_to_be_done: Automatically extract physical site constraints (grade, shade, existing structures) from raw video.
Rapidly iterate on spatial zoning using natural language (e.g., 'move the patio away from the property line').
Instantly translate spatial zones into preliminary material estimates and budget impacts to qualify the design.
success_criteria: The user feels the AI understands physical space and constraints, not just text.
The interaction feels like a fluid conversation with a junior architect, not a rigid form-based wizard.
Feels differentiated from generic SaaS by replacing complex CAD menus with natural language spatial commands overlaid on real imagery.

ai_inference_points.input: Raw video frames of the backyard.
ai_inference_points.output_shape: Structured JSON of site constraints (slope percentages, shade polygons, identified existing trees/structures) rendered as an interactive overlay on the video.
ai_inference_points.value_unlocked: Eliminates hours of manual site measurement and environmental analysis, establishing immediate trust in the AI's spatial awareness.

ai_inference_points.trigger: User types 'Let's add a 15x15 flagstone patio in the sunniest spot.'
ai_inference_points.input: User prompt + current site constraint JSON.
ai_inference_points.output_shape: Updated spatial coordinates for the patio zone rendered on the map, plus a conversational confirmation ('Placed in the SW corner. Note: requires minor grading due to a 5% slope.').
ai_inference_points.value_unlocked: Translates creative intent into precise spatial data instantly, acting as a true co-designer.

ai_inference_points.input: Current spatial zones (area, perimeter, material type) + local pricing database context.
ai_inference_points.output_shape: Itemized JSON table of materials, quantities (e.g., tons of base rock, sq ft of flagstone), and estimated costs, rendered as a dynamic side-panel.
ai_inference_points.value_unlocked: Connects creative design directly to business reality, allowing Elena to know if the design fits the client's budget before drafting CAD.

hard_constraints.brand: Earthy, precise, and professional. UI should feel like a modern architectural tool (dark mode, high contrast accent colors for spatial zones).
hard_constraints.accessibility: WCAG AA minimum, ensuring high contrast for spatial overlays and screen-reader support for the chat interface.
other: Must simulate real-time video processing realistically (e.g., showing a skeleton mesh overlaying the video).

open_questions: How do we handle edge cases where the video doesn't capture property lines accurately?
What is the UI fallback if the AI misinterprets a spatial command and places a zone incorrectly?
Should the user be able to manually drag-and-drop zones after the AI places them, or is it strictly chat-driven?

behavior_per_state.default: Dashed border, muted text 'Drag & Drop Site Walk Video'.
behavior_per_state.hover: Border glows with high-contrast accent color (e.g., neon topographical green), background slightly lightens.
behavior_per_state.active: Scale down slightly (0.98x), border becomes solid.
behavior_per_state.loading: Replaced by a sleek progress bar and thumbnail of the first video frame.
behavior_per_state.success: Checkmark animation, immediate transition to processing screen.

behavior_per_state.default: Semi-transparent terracotta fill with dashed outline.
behavior_per_state.hover: Fill opacity increases to 80%, tooltip appears showing '225 sqft'.
behavior_per_state.active: Solid outline, corner drag handles appear for manual adjustment.
behavior_per_state.loading: Shimmering/pulsing fill while AI calculates exact coordinates.

behavior_per_state.default: Dark mode input box, placeholder 'Describe a zone or constraint...'
behavior_per_state.loading: Input disabled, send button turns into a spinning topographical icon.
behavior_per_state.error: Red border, helper text 'Could not parse spatial command. Try being more specific.'

motion_contract.encodes: Communicates that the AI is actively scanning and understanding physical 3D space, building trust in the extraction process.
The zone grows from the center point outward to its final dimensions, encoding the AI translating a text concept into a physical footprint.
Slides in from the left while pushing the map slightly right, encoding that the budget data is a layer built upon the spatial context, not a separate page.
Toggling 'Shade' fades the map to grayscale while highlighting shade polygons in deep blue, encoding environmental data hierarchy.

ai_flows.system_prompt_outline: You are an expert landscape architect and surveyor. Analyze the provided video frames. Identify physical constraints: slope direction and percentage, shade coverage based on existing trees/structures, and property boundaries.
ai_flows.user_message_template: [Attached Video: {{video_file}}] Extract site constraints into structured JSON.

ai_flows.system_prompt_outline: You are a spatial reasoning co-designer. You receive the current site constraints and a user request. You must determine the optimal coordinates for the requested feature, ensuring it respects constraints (e.g., placing a patio in the sun), and return the coordinates plus a conversational explanation.
ai_flows.user_message_template: Current Constraints: {{site_constraints_json}}. User Request: '{{user_chat_input}}'. Return updated zone coordinates and a brief response.
ai_flows.renders_into: s4_workspace_zoned map polygon and chat history

ai_flows.system_prompt_outline: You are a landscape construction estimator. Given a set of spatial zones, their areas, and underlying constraints (like slope requiring grading), generate a preliminary itemized bill of materials and estimated costs based on standard local pricing.
ai_flows.user_message_template: Zones: {{design_zones_json}}. Constraints overlapping zones: {{overlapping_constraints_json}}. Generate material estimate.

brand_application.voice_tone: consulting-grade, restrained, declarative, no marketing copy, no hyperbole

critique.summary: The prototype fails to implement the hard constraint of a dark mode UI, instead defaulting to a light theme and introducing rogue colors not found in the Design System. Additionally, it contains blocking interaction bugs, such as an empty onClick handler for the Settings button and non-functional map layer toggles.

issues.description: The Brief explicitly requires a dark mode UI ('UI should feel like a modern architectural tool (dark mode...)'). The prototype uses a light mode foundation.
issues.fix: Map the Design System's dark hexes (#0D0D0D, #525252) to the background and surface tokens, and invert text colors to #FFFFFF and #FAFAFA to create a compliant dark mode.

issues.description: Rogue hex codes were introduced that do not exist in the Design System (e.g., #F5F5F0, #ACACAC, #0d3d40).
issues.fix: Strictly use only the hex codes provided in the Design System. Use opacity modifiers (rgba) on these exact hexes if subtle shading is needed.

issues.description: The Settings button has no onClick handler, rendering it dead UI.
issues.fix: Wire the Settings button to a state that toggles a settings panel or modal.

issues.description: The layer toggles in the MapViewport are purely visual and do not actually filter the constraint polygons.
issues.fix: Add state for active layers and filter the rendered SVG polygons based on this state.

research_goal: Identify a comprehensive new strategy for co-op based on the current statement of work for NU, prior projects with NU, and fresh industry analysis of experiential learning and co-op engagement tactics to improve learner's chances of gaining meaningful experiential learning opportunities from pre-enrollment to graduate school
